description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmpEmergencyContactService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains tests for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee emergency contact data, verifying the functionality of the service layer of the application.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmpEmergencyContactService functionalities, including CRUD operations and search features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates the service and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific emergency contact for an employee.

methods.name: testSaveEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests saving a new emergency contact.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests deletion of emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests searching for emergency contacts based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Tests obtaining the count of search results for emergency contacts.
